input.summary: Base a week-long sailing trip in the Dalmatian coast (Split, Hvar, Vis) in late June. Expect 27-30 C days, sea around 23-24 C, calm mornings and a NW afternoon breeze of 10-15 kn. input.summary: For more comfort, keep the Dalmatian route (Split, Hvar, Vis) but upgrade how you sail it. Take a skippered charter on a larger catamaran or a well-equipped yacht, with cabins for each of you and air conditioning. Late June should have 27-30 C days, sea around 23-24 C and a gentle afternoon breeze, though the weather figures came from a source labelled simulated. The specialists found no upscale options, so the two quiet stops are the same as before, and the comfort upgrades are my own suggestions.
